access: Existing user-authenticated Chrome session, as directed by the user
scope: Published profile grid; excludes archived posts, stories, highlights, tagged posts and DMs

setComparison.serialization: Sort lines id|mediaType|carousel (lowercase boolean) lexicographically; join with LF and no trailing LF
setComparison.algorithm: FNV-1a-32, used only to compare the browser inventory with the local catalog

retrieval.ownership: A concurrent local import supplied the media; this pass independently verified the authenticated profile inventory and local files
retrieval.diagnosticsResolution: No further browser downloads required after concurrent import completed
